dialogues.jp:
テストも終わりぐっすりと眠ったこともあって、
今日の調子はすこぶる……。
dialogues.en: The exam week's finally over, and I slept well, I feel......
dialogues.text: The exam week's finally over, and I slept well, I feel......

dialogues.jp: かったるい。
dialogues.en: What a pain.
dialogues.text: What a pain.

dialogues.jp:
「日曜の午前中は家でごろごろしてるに限る
　なぁ」
dialogues.en: "It's best to laze around the house on Sunday mornings."
dialogues.text: "It's best to laze around the house on Sunday mornings."

dialogues.jp:
トイレからの帰り道、居間に人気を感じて立ち
止まる。
dialogues.en:
I stopped as I felt something on the way back from the
bathroom.
dialogues.text:
I stopped as I felt something on the way back from the
bathroom.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん、なに？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? What?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? What?"

dialogues.jp: 食い入るようにテレビに見入っている妹。
dialogues.en: My sister's staring at the TV.
dialogues.text: My sister's staring at the TV.

dialogues.jp: 「なにやってるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「テスト期間中にたまったビデオを片付けてる
　の。あんまりうるさくしないでね」
dialogues.en:
"I'm watching the videos I taped during the exam week, so be
quiet, OK?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm watching the videos I taped during the exam week, so be
quiet, OK?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ビデオ？　俺が不思議なのは、その総攻撃と
　ばかりに山と積まれたお菓子とジュースなん
　だが」
dialogues.en:
"Videos? What I'm wondering is what's with that mountain of
snacks and juice."
dialogues.text:
"Videos? What I'm wondering is what's with that mountain of
snacks and juice."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
ようやく俺に気づいたとばかりに、音夢が首を
曲げる――録画したビデオがＣＭに入ったとも
いう。
dialogues.en:
She finally turned as if she's just noticed me. I think it's
because the commercial break came on.
dialogues.text:
She finally turned as if she's just noticed me. I think it's
because the commercial break came on.

dialogues.jp: 「いつから見てるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "How long have you been watching them?"
dialogues.text: "How long have you been watching them?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「朝からだよ。午後から美春と商店街に買い物
　に行くから、それまでに見ちゃわないと」
dialogues.en:
"Since this morning. I'm going shopping with Miharu this
afternoon, so I have to finish watching them by then."
dialogues.text:
"Since this morning. I'm going shopping with Miharu this
afternoon, so I have to finish watching them by then."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "This morning?"
dialogues.text: "This morning?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Since 5 o'clock."
dialogues.text: "Since 5 o'clock."

dialogues.jp: う〜ん、と背伸び。
dialogues.en: She stretched her back.
dialogues.text: She stretched her back.

dialogues.jp: ふと時計を見ると、今は１１時。
dialogues.en: I looked at the clock, and it said 11 o'clock.
dialogues.text: I looked at the clock, and it said 11 o'clock.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ドラマが３本と映画が１本、後はドキュメン
　タリーだったかな」
dialogues.en:
"I watched three soap operas, one movie, and the rest were
some documentaries."
dialogues.text:
"I watched three soap operas, one movie, and the rest were
some documentaries."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ずっと？」
dialogues.en: "The whole time?"
dialogues.text: "The whole time?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「途中でご飯を買いに外に出たよ」
dialogues.en: "I went out to get some breakfast in between."
dialogues.text: "I went out to get some breakfast in between."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それだけか」
dialogues.en: "That's all?"
dialogues.text: "That's all?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「朝風呂も入ったわよ」
dialogues.en: "I took a shower, too."
dialogues.text: "I took a shower, too."

dialogues.jp:
しゃら〜ん、ときめ細かい肌でも表現したいの
か、音夢が手と指を優雅に伸ばす。
dialogues.en:
Nemu stretched her arm out elegantly to show off her smooth
skin.
dialogues.text:
Nemu stretched her arm out elegantly to show off her smooth
skin.

dialogues.jp:
どちらかというと、スカートから伸びた白い足
に目がいくが。
dialogues.en:
But her fair-skinned legs stretching from her skirt looked
more appealing to me.
dialogues.text:
But her fair-skinned legs stretching from her skirt looked
more appealing to me.

dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」

俺に言えることなどなにもないだろう。日曜の
使い方に文句などない。
dialogues.en:
There's nothing I can say. However she wants to spend her
Sunday is up to her.
dialogues.text:
There's nothing I can say. However she wants to spend her
Sunday is up to her.

dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、がんばれ」
dialogues.en: "Well, have fun."
dialogues.text: "Well, have fun."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん。後ちょっとだからね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. I'm almost done."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. I'm almost done."

dialogues.jp:
テスト勉強の時よりも高い集中力とやる気で、
胸の前で拳を握り締める。
dialogues.en:
She's concentrating much harder now than when she was
studying for the exams, and she grips her fist in front of
her chest.
dialogues.text:
She's concentrating much harder now than when she was
studying for the exams, and she grips her fist in front of
her chest.

dialogues.jp:
皮肉にすら気づいてくれない妹にため息をつき
つつ、俺は自分の部屋でだらだらしようと居間
を出た。
dialogues.en:
I sighed at my dull sister who didn't even get my sarcasm
and left the living room to hang out in my room.
dialogues.text:
I sighed at my dull sister who didn't even get my sarcasm
and left the living room to hang out in my room.

dialogues.jp: ◆ビデオ観賞◆
dialogues.en: ◆Watching videos◆
dialogues.text: ◆Watching videos◆

dialogues.jp:
居間で音夢がテスト中にためたビデオを見てい
た。しかも朝の５時からとか……。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was watching the videos she taped during the exam week.
She's been watching them since 5 in the morning......
dialogues.text:
Nemu was watching the videos she taped during the exam week.
She's been watching them since 5 in the morning......

dialogues.jp: 日曜の使い方に文句はないが……まあ頑張れ。
dialogues.en:
I can't say anything about how she spends her Sunday,
but...... have fun.
dialogues.text:
I can't say anything about how she spends her Sunday,
but...... have fun.

dialogues.jp:
テスト勉強の時よりも高い集中力とやる気の音
夢を残し、自室へと引き上げるのだった。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was concentrating on the TV more than she was during
the test week, so I decided to leave her in the living room
and went back to my room.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was concentrating on the TV more than she was during
the test week, so I decided to leave her in the living room
and went back to my room.
